title: Fastcure
description: Cure zombie villagers in just 10 seconds instead of minutes.
body:
⚡ Fast Cure

Fast Cure is a simple and lightweight mod that reduces the time required to cure zombie villagers.

✨ Features
- ⚡ Zombie villagers are cured in just 10 seconds
- 🧪 Fully compatible with vanilla mechanics (Weakness + Golden Apple)
- 🚀 Lightweight and performance-friendly
- 🔧 No configuration needed

⚙️ How it works
Normally, curing a zombie villager takes several minutes.  
With Fast Cure, the conversion time is reduced to only 10 seconds, making villager curing much faster and more convenient.

🧪 Compatibility
- Minecraft 1.20.6
- Fabric Loader

👤 Author
PolCT

---

Enjoy faster villager curing and improve your gameplay experience! 🚀
